1879064386.name: Guide to Bree
1879064386.desc: Returns you and your Fellowship to Bree.\n\nThis skill is easily interrupted.

1879089858.name: Guide to Ost Guruth
1879089858.desc: Returns you and your Fellowship to Ost Guruth in the Lone-lands.\n\nThis skill is easily interrupted.

1879093058.name: Bob and Weave
1879093058.desc: Sometimes survival comes down to not being hit. Actually, most times.

1879097282.name: Back from the Brink
1879097282.desc: Revives a defeated ally.\n\n(Can only be used out of combat.)

1879102530.name: Contact Pedlar
1879102530.desc: At camp-sites, call a Pedlar to whom you and others may sell items.

1879136962.name: Blood Lust
1879136962.desc: The sight of your opponents falling before you feeds your thirst for blood. The greater your wounds, the greater your fury.\n\n   <rgb=#00FFDD>Requires a Defeat Response</rgb>

1879210818.name: Skirmisher: Hindering Shot
1879210818.desc: A shaft aimed to slow the movement of your quarry.

1879212098.name: Spider Leg
1879212098.desc: Poking friends with spider legs makes for lots of laughs.

1879213890.name: A Flesh Wound (Melee)
1879213890.desc: Your Fellowship strikes at Draigoch's front right leg, reducing its ability to resist damage.

1879215042.name: Good Map to Tol Ascarnen
1879215042.desc: A well drawn and detailed map to Tol Ascarnen.

1879230274.name: Topple
1879230274.desc: You strike your opponent with great force, knocking them off their feet.

1879231426.name: Ranged Offensive Strike
1879231426.desc: A swift attack.\n\n<rgb=#FF7700>Using will restore this skill to Battle Memory.</rgb>

1879233858.name: War-steed: Heavy
1879233858.desc: The Destrier is a heavily armoured War-steed. Stalwart and imposing, The Destrier is bred for battle. The least agile and slowest of the war-steeds trades speed and maneuverability.

1879242306.name: Bond of the Rider
1879242306.desc: So complete is the Lore-master's understanding and bond with their War-steed that they can influence the morale and state of a war-steed.

1879244866.name: Roar of the Eorlingas
1879244866.desc: You issue a loud cry drawing the heart out of the enemy, dealing damage and slightly increasing threat against the target.\n\n<rgb=#66ffff>Applies the Shout effect to you. Skill of the Eorlingas becomes Halt the Charge.</rgb>

1879245634.name: Inspirational Verse
1879245634.desc: You focus your energies and etchings toward supporting you and your allies finding inspiration in the verses.

1879245762.name: Spur On
1879245762.desc: You drive your War-steed to carry you directly to a foe.\n\n<rgb=#FF6600>Your next non-self targeted skill will move you directly toward your target, executing the skill when you are in range. This effect is consumed when a skill is successfully executed.</rgb>

1879248322.name: Ballad - Saga
1879248322.desc: Sagas tell tales of old that speak of the victory of light over darkness.

1879267650.name: Large Fish-Net
1879267650.desc: Throw a large net to catch fish.

1879302594.name: Call to Arms: Archer (Swordswoman)
1879302594.desc: You enlist an Archer to assist you in battle.

1879357634.name: Journey to the Court of Lothlórien
1879357634.desc: Journey to the Allegiance Hall: The Court of Lothlórien

1879368642.name: Black Peahen
1879368642.desc: Brings out a black peahen to keep you company.

1879391426.name: Call to Arms: Herald of Victory (Elvish Maid-at-arms)
1879391426.desc: You enlist a Herald to carry your Banner of Victory into battle. This banner reduces power costs of those around it.

1879410882.name: Steed of the Shimmering Breeze
1879410882.desc: A distinguished steed who has seen fit to carry you.

1879411778.name: Knee Strike
1879411778.desc: You bring your knee up in a sudden strike.

1879414210.name: Goat of Winter Cheer
1879414210.desc: A Goat steed, perfect for delivering gifts to the farthest corners of Middle-earth.

1879451330.name: Herb-tender Stance
1879451330.desc: You focus on concoctions of foul herbs and fungi to push your allies through their pain.\n\nOnly one stance may be active at a time. You can only change stances outside of combat.

1879454274.name: Muster at Andrath
1879454274.desc: Allows the Warden to travel to Andrath in Cardolan.

1879476802.name: Wily Macaque
1879476802.desc: Summons a wily macaque to accompany you on your journeys.

1879484866.name: Muster in Bej Mâgha
1879484866.desc: Allows the Warden to travel to the fishing village of Bej Mâgha on the Cape of Umbar.

1879492162.name: White-hot Whip
1879492162.desc: Your whip cracks with blistering speed, damaging your foe at greater range than normal melee weapons can reach.

1879503554.name: Call Mizâdi
1879503554.desc: Blow the horn to summon Mizâdi to your side.

1879506626.name: Shadow-spike
1879506626.desc: Send a shadowy spike at your target, dealing damage and reducing their tactical prowess.<rgb=#00ffff>\n\nCan be prepared as a Sorcerous Study.</rgb>

1879508162.name: Sneak
1879508162.desc: Move about unseen while Sneaking.\n\nThere is a chance enemies will detect you, especially when you move in front of them.

1879508546.name: Young Brown Oryx
1879508546.desc: Summons a young brown oryx to accompany you on your adventures.

1879516866.name: Leaping Fish Kite
1879516866.desc: Brings out a leaping fish kite for you to fly in the wind.
